senses.sense_definition: A pleasant feeling of relaxation or dreaminess.

examples.text: She spent the afternoon in a state of <w>languor</w>, enjoying the warm sun on her face.
The soft music and comfortable chair induced a deep <w>languor</w> that made it hard to stay awake.

senses.sense_definition: A feeling of physical or mental tiredness caused by illness or exhaustion.

examples.text: After the long fever, a heavy <w>languor</w> remained in her limbs for several weeks.
The patient struggled with a persistent <w>languor</w> that prevented him from returning to work.

senses.sense_definition: A heavy, still, and humid quality of the air.

examples.text: A strange <w>languor</w> hung in the air before the summer storm finally broke.
The afternoon heat brought a thick <w>languor</w> to the garden, making everything feel perfectly still.

senses.sense_definition: To become weak, tired, or lose energy.

examples.text: The flowers began to <w>languor</w> in the intense heat of the midday sun.
Without proper care, the neglected plants will surely <w>languor</w> and eventually die.
